structuredOutput.summary:
Inherited decisions: Wave 4 candidate p316-20260904115717-f8c5609e32d4 is PACKAGE_PASS_AWAITING_A07_A08_A64; Wave 5 remains closed until independent audits and A01 checkpoint/tag. Candidate identity, source hash, EXE/ASAR/installer hashes, and the accepted ok:true native UAT evidence are authoritative; failed/debug attempts are not acceptance evidence. A64 scope was adversarial red-team, read-only, with renderer/local-storage state treated as untrusted.

Diagnosis: I tried to falsify the trust-boundary claims from source and evidence. The main security boundary is in Electron main/backend, not renderer state: primary renderer IPC is origin/window checked, mediaRoot is overwritten by main-owned app userData, confirmation resolution channels are not exposed through the primary preload, privileged confirmations use separate nonce-bound modal BrowserWindows, and backend appends authority/prepared/generation/canonical records only after proposal/confirmation revalidation. The backend ledger validates sequence, prevMac, duplicate ids, signed tail, stale authority, exact prepared root binding, one-use generation token deletion, manifest changes, receipt output verification, reject-then-approve, and duplicate canonical approvals. Evidence shows two genuine distinct 512x512 PNGs, matching sidecars, worker/component digests, cold/warm telemetry, no worker sockets, no ComfyUI/8188/completion POST, live profile unchanged, external roots unchanged, and cleanup complete.

Drift / contradiction check: I found no material drift from the Wave 4 gate. The package/source identities recompute and match. The accepted evidence set is distinguishable from earlier debug/recovery files. One non-blocking documentation overclaim remains: authority-review.html/preload does not implement the same Escape/focus trap behavior visible in confirmation-preload.cjs, so the blanket modal accessibility wording should not be read as literally true for the large authority review window. This is not a privilege bypass because close/cancel resolves false and the authority review IPC is nonce/sender-bound.

Recommendation: PASS A64. No executor handoff is warranted. Keep Wave 5 closed until A07/A08 and A01 checkpoint/tag complete, but I do not have an A64 veto blocker.
